OFFICE LEASE AGREEMENT

THIS OFFICE LEASE AGREEMENT (this "Lease") is made as of April 15, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Marlow Tower Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Landlord"), and Bellweather Analytics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Tenant").

1. Premises.

1.1 Landlord leases to Tenant, and Tenant leases from Landlord, Suite 1400 on the fourteenth floor of the building located at 220 Marlow Street, Chicago, Illinois (the "Building"), containing approximately 12,400 rentable square feet (the "Premises"), as shown on the floor plan attached as Exhibit A.

1.2 Tenant shall have the non-exclusive right to use the Building's common areas, including lobbies, elevators, and restrooms, in common with other tenants.

2. Term.

2.1 The term of this Lease is seven (7) years, beginning on July 1, 2026 (the "Commencement Date") and ending on June 30, 2033 (the "Expiration Date"), unless sooner terminated as provided in this Lease.

2.2 Tenant has one option to extend the term for five (5) years at the then-prevailing fair market rent, exercisable by written notice given not less than nine (9) months and not more than twelve (12) months before the Expiration Date.

3. Rent.

3.1 Tenant shall pay base rent of $37.50 per rentable square foot per year, payable in equal monthly installments of $38,750.00 in advance on the first day of each month, without demand, deduction, or offset.

3.2 Base rent increases by three percent (3%) on each anniversary of the Commencement Date.

3.3 Tenant shall pay its proportionate share of operating expenses and real estate taxes over a base year of calendar year 2026. Tenant's proportionate share is 4.2%, calculated as the rentable area of the Premises divided by the rentable area of the Building.

3.4 Landlord shall deliver an annual reconciliation statement within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each calendar year. Tenant may audit Landlord's records for the reconciled year on thirty (30) days' notice, and Landlord shall refund any overcharge within thirty (30) days after the audit.

3.5 Controllable operating expenses shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) per year on a cumulative basis.

3.6 Rent not paid within five (5) days after its due date bears a late charge of five percent (5%) of the overdue amount, and unpaid amounts accrue interest at the lesser of ten percent (10%) per year or the maximum rate permitted by Illinois law.

4. Security Deposit.

4.1 Tenant shall deposit $116,250.00 with Landlord on execution of this Lease as security for Tenant's performance. Landlord shall return the deposit, less any amounts properly applied, within forty-five (45) days after the Expiration Date.

5. Use.

5.1 Tenant shall use the Premises for general office purposes and for no other purpose without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.

5.2 Tenant shall comply with all applicable laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act, in its use of the Premises.

6. Landlord's Obligations; Services.

6.1 Landlord shall maintain the Building's structure, roof, foundation, exterior walls, and base building systems in good condition and repair.

6.2 Landlord shall provide HVAC service to the Premises between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. on business days, electricity sufficient for general office use, water, elevator service, and janitorial service five nights per week.

6.3 If an interruption of services within Landlord's reasonable control renders the Premises untenantable for more than five (5) consecutive business days, base rent abates proportionately until service is restored.

7. Tenant's Obligations; Alterations.

7.1 Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises in good order and repair, ordinary wear and tear excepted.

7.2 Tenant shall not make alterations to the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld for non-structural alterations that do not affect base building systems. Tenant may install its own furniture, fixtures, and equipment without consent.

7.3 On the Expiration Date, Tenant shall surrender the Premises in the condition required by this Lease and shall remove its personal property. Tenant is not obligated to remove any alteration unless Landlord notified Tenant at the time of consent that removal would be required.

8. Assignment and Subletting.

8.1 Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet all or part of the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.

8.2 Tenant may assign this Lease or sublet the Premises to an Affiliate, or to a successor by merger or purchase of all or substantially all of Tenant's assets, without Landlord's consent, on ten (10) days' prior written notice.

9. Insurance; Waiver of Subrogation.

9.1 Tenant shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 in the aggregate, and property insurance covering its personal property and alterations at full replacement cost.

9.2 Landlord shall maintain property insurance on the Building at full replacement cost and commercial general liability insurance in commercially reasonable amounts.

9.3 Landlord and Tenant each waive all rights of recovery against the other for loss or damage covered by property insurance, and each shall cause its property insurer to consent to this waiver of subrogation.

10. Indemnity.

10.1 Tenant shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Landlord from and against any claim arising out of Tenant's use of the Premises, except to the extent caused by Landlord's negligence or willful misconduct.

10.2 Landlord shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Tenant from and against any claim arising out of Landlord's operation of the common areas, except to the extent caused by Tenant's negligence or willful misconduct.

11. Damage and Destruction; Condemnation.

11.1 If the Premises are damaged by fire or other casualty, Landlord shall repair the damage with reasonable diligence, and base rent abates proportionately to the portion of the Premises rendered untenantable until repairs are substantially complete.

11.2 If the damage cannot reasonably be repaired within two hundred seventy (270) days, either party may terminate this Lease by written notice given within thirty (30) days after the casualty.

11.3 If all or a material part of the Premises is taken by condemnation, this Lease terminates as of the date of taking, and each party may pursue its own award.

12. Default and Remedies.

12.1 Tenant is in default if Tenant fails to pay rent within five (5) days after written notice that it is past due, or fails to perform any other obligation within thirty (30) days after written notice describing the failure, provided that if the failure cannot reasonably be cured within thirty (30) days, Tenant is not in default so long as Tenant begins to cure within that period and pursues the cure diligently.

12.2 On a default, Landlord may terminate this Lease or Tenant's right to possession, recover possession, and recover damages, and shall use commercially reasonable efforts to relet the Premises and mitigate its damages.

12.3 Landlord is in default if Landlord fails to perform any obligation within thirty (30) days after written notice, subject to the same extension for a cure that cannot reasonably be completed in that period.

13. Quiet Enjoyment; Subordination.

13.1 So long as Tenant is not in default, Tenant shall peaceably hold and enjoy the Premises without interference by Landlord or anyone claiming through Landlord.

13.2 This Lease is subordinate to any mortgage on the Building, provided that the holder delivers a commercially reasonable non-disturbance agreement recognizing Tenant's rights so long as Tenant is not in default.

13.3 Tenant shall deliver an estoppel certificate within ten (10) business days after Landlord's written request.

14. General.

14.1 This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois.

14.2 Any action arising out of this Lease shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in Cook County, Illinois.

14.3 Notices must be in writing and delivered by hand, overnight courier, or certified mail to the addresses set out below, and are effective on receipt.

14.4 This Lease, together with its Exhibits, is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations. It may be amended only by a writing signed by both parties.

14.5 If any provision of this Lease is held unenforceable, the remainder remains in effect.

14.6 Neither party is liable for a failure to perform caused by an event beyond its reasonable control, except that this Section does not excuse Tenant's obligation to pay rent.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Lease as of the Effective Date.
